Event from 21 to 26 February; the individual mission takes 30–60 min

Annual world event: {creature:Cake Golem|Cake Golems} invade five cities. Players gather sugary substances and lure golems into extraction machines until a bridge is built to the {wiki:Cake Keep Isle}, south of Cormaya, where the whole world has to eat a giant four-layer cake. If the world succeeds, it gets a seven-day bonus and each player can do {npc:Brutus The Baker}'s mission to choose a cake item and a cupcake.

Defeat the invading cake golems and use the bodies of the defeated enemies to build a bridge to a legendary island that can only be visited once a year. There you will face a challenge unlike any other. Grab your fork and get ready.
Only during the event: 21 to 26 February.
Phase 2 needs lots of hungry players (at least 87 per layer of the cake).
avoid drunkenness when luring Cake Golems to the machines
For the world (if successful): 7 days with 25% faster health and mana regeneration and +50% experience for Premium players
One of your choice: {item:Cake Cabinet Kit}, {item:Cake Backpack} or {item:Cake Tapestry}
One cupcake of your choice: {item:Blueberry Cupcake}, {item:Strawberry Cupcake} or {item:Lemon Cupcake}
Achievements **Cake Conqueror** and **I Did My Part**
Use a {item:Dwarven Ring} when luring Cake Golems to the machines, so you don't get drunk.
In phase 2 go to Cormaya **hungry** (not regenerating), so you can take the maximum number of bites out of the cake.
1. Phase one: Cake Golems in the cities

When the event starts there are raids of {creature:Cake Golem|Cake Golems} in Thais, Carlin, Edron, Darashia and Liberty Bay, once an hour from the server save (the first is at SS+1), until the phase 2 requirements are met.
Next to each {item:Cake Extraction Machine} there is a Magic Bakery Alliance baker and a copy of the book {item:A Piece of Cake I (Book)}, which explains this phase.
To the northwest, near a Wasp Tower {coord:33192,32398,7}
Hand in the Sweet and Sugary Substance

Kill some Cake Golems to collect {item:Sweet and Sugary Substance} and hand them in to the baker next to the machine. The world needs **200** in total. Say {key:mass} to any baker to find out how many have already been handed in.
Lure Cake Golems to the machines
You also need to lure **200** Cake Golems to be *extracted* in the machines. Say {key:base} to any baker to find out how many have already been lured.
Use a {item:Dwarven Ring} to avoid drunkenness while luring the golems.
Every 10 minutes the server checks whether the substances and golems have all been handed in. When that happens, the bridge in the south of **Cormaya** is built and phase 2 begins.

Go to the bridge at the far south of **Cormaya**, the island south of Edron: on the boat **north** of Edron talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} and say {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at the **north** harbour of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret}; from there cross the island on foot **south** to the bridge. There you will find a huge cake and the book {item:A Piece of Cake II (Book)}, which explains this phase. The bridge leads to {wiki:Cake Keep Isle|Cake Keep Isle}.
Bridge and giant cake, south of Cormaya
To leave, go back over the bridge and cross Cormaya **north** to the harbour; {npc:Pemaret} takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 20 gp).
The giant cake south of Cormaya

Once the bridge is built, every **30 minutes** there is an event in which the cake has to be eaten. If the whole layer is eaten (except the corners), the next layer drops; if not, the layer resets and you have to try again. Step on a spot where the cake has already been eaten to get the **Cake Conqueror** achievement.
Before you start, gather lots of **hungry** people (not regenerating) in Cormaya so they can rush the cake as soon as the 30 minutes begin.

When all **4 layers** are eaten, the world quest is complete. If the server completes a layer within the 30 minutes, that layer is saved and you carry on from there (message *"One layer of the cake-tower has been eaten!"*).

After the cake has been entirely eaten, {npc:Brutus The Baker} appears on the island after the next server save. Your world gets 7 days of +25% health and mana regeneration and +50% experience for Premium.

Say {key:hi} and {key:help} to {npc:Brutus The Baker}. He asks you to step on the {item:Cake Base} on the island and then visit one of the extraction machines, repeating these two steps for each city.
You can start stepping on the Cake Base before talking to Brutus: if your world eats the whole cake, you get ahead on the work and hand in the task when he appears at the next server save.

Alternate between the Cake Base on the island and each machine until you have visited them all. For example: Cake Isle → Liberty Bay → Cake Isle → Thais → Cake Isle → Carlin → Cake Isle → Darashia → Cake Isle → Edron → Cake Isle. Each trip to the island always follows the same route: boat to Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} to Cormaya ({key:cormaya}), on foot to the bridge in the south; to return, {npc:Pemaret} at Cormaya's north harbour ({key:edron}) and from there the boat to the next city.

Go back to {npc:Brutus The Baker} and say {key:reward}. Choose **one** cake item ({item:Cake Cabinet Kit}, {item:Cake Backpack} or {item:Cake Tapestry}) and **one** cupcake ({item:Blueberry Cupcake}, {item:Strawberry Cupcake} or {item:Lemon Cupcake}).
You can only choose one of the three cake items and one of the three cupcakes.
Cake item + cupcake of your choice
The **I Did My Part** achievement is also one of the event's individual rewards.
Since 2018 the world experience bonus has been 50% for seven days, for Premium players only (before, it was 5% for five days).
